# 1 Samuel Chapter 27 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **Book:** 1 Samuel | **Chapter:** 27

---

### Verse 1
- **EMET:** "-- הִמָּלֵט אִמָּלֵט (I-should-escape, yes-escape): Infinitive absolute + imperfect construction expressing David's resolved determination. The verb נ..."
- **LOGOS:** "And David said in his heart, "Now I shall be swept away one day by the hand of Saul. There is nothing better for me than to escape into the land of th..."
- **PNEUMA:** "David thought to himself, "One of these days Saul is going to kill me. The best thing I can do is escape to Philistine territory. Then Saul will give ..."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 2
- **EMET:** "And-arose David, and-he-crossed-over, he and-six hundred man who [were] with-him, to Akhish (Achish) son of-Ma'okh (Maoch), king of-Gat (Gath)."
- **LOGOS:** "So David arose and crossed over, he and the six hundred men who were with him, to Achish son of Maoch, king of Gath."
- **PNEUMA:** "So David crossed over with his six hundred men to Achish son of Maoch, king of Gath."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 3
- **EMET:** "And-dwelt David with Akhish (Achish) in-Gat (Gath), he and-his-men, each and-his-household -- David and-his-two wives, Akhinoam (Ahinoam) the-Yizre'el..."
- **LOGOS:** "And David dwelt with Achish at Gath, he and his men, each with his household — David with his two wives, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess and Abigail the wido..."
- **PNEUMA:** "David settled in Gath with Achish — he and his men, each with their families. David had his two wives with him: Ahinoam of Jezreel and Abigail, Nabal'..."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 5
- **EMET:** "And-said David to Akhish (Achish), "If, please, I-have-found favor in-your-eyes, let-them-give to-me a-place in-one of-[the]-cities of-the-field, and-..."
- **LOGOS:** "And David said to Achish, "If I have found favor in your eyes, let a place be given me in one of the country towns, that I may dwell there. For why sh..."
- **PNEUMA:** "David said to Achish, "If you're willing, give me a place in one of the outlying towns to live in. Why should your servant live in the royal city with..."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 7
- **EMET:** "And-was [the]-number of-the-days which dwelt David in-[the]-field of-[the]-Pelishtim (Philistines): days and-four months."
- **LOGOS:** "And the length of time that David dwelt in the country of the Philistines was a year and four months."
- **PNEUMA:** "David lived in Philistine territory for a year and four months."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 8
- **EMET:** "And-went-up David and-his-men, and-they-raided to the-Geshurim (Geshurites) and-the-Gizrim (Girzites) and-the-Amaleqim (Amalekites), for they [were th..."
- **LOGOS:** "And David and his men went up and raided the Geshurites, the Girzites, and the Amalekites, for these were the inhabitants of the land from of old, as ..."
- **PNEUMA:** "During that time, David and his men raided the Geshurites, the Girzites, and the Amalekites — peoples who had long inhabited the region stretching tow..."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 11
- **EMET:** "And-man or-woman David did-not-keep-alive, to-bring [them] to-Gat (Gath), saying, "Lest they-tell against-us, saying, 'Thus did David.'" And-thus [was..."
- **LOGOS:** "David would leave neither man nor woman alive to bring news to Gath, thinking, "Lest they tell about us and say, 'David did thus.'" Such was his pract..."
- **PNEUMA:** "David left no survivors who could report to Gath, thinking, "They might talk and expose us." This was his practice the entire time he lived in Philist..."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 12
- **EMET:** "And-trusted Akhish (Achish) in-David, saying, "He-has-made-himself-utterly-odious among-his-people, among-Yisra'el (Israel), and-he-will-be to-me a-se..."
- **LOGOS:** "And Achish trusted David, thinking, "He has made himself utterly odious to his people Israel; therefore he shall be my servant forever.""
- **PNEUMA:** "Achish trusted David completely. He thought, "David has made himself so hated among his own people that he'll be my servant forever.""
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.

— SOPHIA
